en:
Prologue:
Heaven was dark and earth was yellow; the cosmos was vast and wild.
Since ancient times the Way and the demonic could never coexist. The world may hold the Way to be righteous, yet the struggle between the Way and the demons has never ceased.
Why, if the Way is righteous, have the demons never been wiped out? Because what makes us righteous or wicked is the heart!
As the saying goes:
The Way is not the Way, the demon is not the demon - good and evil lie in the human heart!
In the martial world there is no one with ears who has not heard the name of Master Wuji, and no one with eyes who does not long to see Master Wuji's peerless grace and matchless skill.
For everyone knows that no maiden alive can resist Master Wuji's faintest smile, and no hero alive can withstand Master Wuji's lightest sword stroke!
Everyone believes that Master Wuji's sword can take an enemy general's head from the midst of a million soldiers, or split a single hair in two - while his smile can break a maiden's heart.
On the night of March 28, as agreed, Wuji met the great archfiend who then plagued the mortal world - the Crimson Demon - for a duel to the death before Demon Cave on Mt. Sanqing.
After the duel Wuji returned wounded, and the Crimson Demon vanished without a trace. No one knows how the duel ended.
Twenty years later...
Little butterfly...? Where did you go??
Brother, so this is where you are! Master couldn't find you, and he's raging up in Wuji Tower. Hurry over and see him!
Okay, you go ahead. I'll be right there.
Huh, where did my little butterfly go??
I'd better go see Master first.
Wuji: Qingfeng, your master is over here...
Brother Liu, snap out of it! He's a demon now!

Haha... Qingfeng, thank... you... My inner demon... is shattered. Put the... Chaos Urn in the heart of the Primal Demonbane Array in Demon... Demon Cave. It will seal every monster of the Myriad Demon Metamorphosis. Now I can... rest...
Wuji is at peace at last.
I'd better go get the Demonbane Sword first!
Finally I get to leave the mountain! Haha...
This place is huge. I'd better be careful or I'll get lost.
The scenery at Sanqing Hall really is first-rate.
So serene and otherworldly. A true holy ground of the Taoists.
They say the immortals here really listen. Every prayer gets answered.
They say Taoist Wuji is an immortal reborn. Now that I've seen him, he truly looks the part.
I hear the gate of Mt. Sanqing was carved by a master craftsman. It really is something special.
With surroundings this lovely, living here must add years to your life.
The world tends only its hearth smoke; I drift out of the mists beyond the dust. Though this body still belongs to the mortal world, my heart has no care for earthly things...
Your disciple greets you, Master. You summoned me in a hurry - what are your orders?
Hmph &$#! Playing around from dawn to dusk! You came second-to-last in the last tournament, and you still won't train properly. All you're good for is embarrassing me.
Master, I wasn't playing! I was practicing a kung fu style I invented myself. Here, let me show you...
All right, all right. Listen. I've been reading the heavens, and an evil aura is shrouding the land below the mountain - and it's growing thicker. I was going to send you down to take a look.
Great! I'll set off right away.
Listen. The way you are now, you'd only embarrass me down there. Go to Demon Cave on the back mountain and retrieve the Demonbane Sword. Only then may you leave the mountain.

To get the Demonbane Sword you must pass three trials. First, open the Puzzle Door where the sword is kept. Second, defeat the Swordwarden. Third, dodge the falling rocks. It's time you got some real training. Go.
May I ask, Master, how do I pass these three trials?
That's for you to figure out.
Go. Come back to me once you have the sword.
Master, I've brought back the sword.
Heh heh, I fully expected you'd get it! Well? You're not hurt, are you?
When I pulled out the sword, the whole mountain shook. It felt like something big happened. And on my way out of the cave a rock smashed my hand.
Oh? Go get that bandaged, then. Leave the sword here with me.
Handed the Demonbane Sword over to Wuji.
Go and pack, then head down the mountain. Remember: to slay demons and defend the Way is your duty. Always keep the people of the world in your heart.
Go and pack, then head down the mountain.
Master, I went down to investigate. It turned out a half-man, half-snake monster was wreaking havoc in Heartsease village. I've destroyed it, but some villagers were still killed or hurt.
Good timing. Your Uncle Chongxu just sent word by carrier pigeon: a horde of demons is attacking Mt. Zhong, and he's asking for help.
You've been seasoned down there, so you should manage. I must stay and hold the fort here, in case it's a ploy to lure me away.
It's a long road. Rest a little before you go.
There's quite a selection of good medicine here.
You rest a while. HP restored.
Had a good rest, feeling great. Time to head out.
I'd better go see Master first. I can play later.
Ow, my hand hurts. Good thing I'm fast on my feet, or I'd have been a goner for sure.
Whoa, it caved in again! Terrifying. Back to Master.
Truly a fine sword! Now I can report to Master and head down the mountain.
This Swordwarden really is tough. I almost didn't beat him.
Something feels off... What's that noise???
Swordwarden: Who dares lay a hand on the Demonbane Sword?
Oops, I almost forgot about the Swordwarden.
Swordwarden: Kid, what are you back here for? I never accepted losing to you last time. This time I'll beat you without any helpers.
Demons are plaguing the land right now. Dealing with them comes first.
Swordwarden: Fine. Today you go slay your demons, and we'll have our rematch another day.
Swordwarden: Sigh, the young really are to be feared! I can't believe I lost again. Oh well, oh well... how humiliating. I'm off!
The Chaos Urn is in place.
Taoist: Reporting, Brother Sect Head! I've found the spot with the most crickets and butterflies.
Your son's this big already and all you do is play! You don't act like a father one bit!
Yikes! The old lady's back! Quick, let's run, or she'll nag me until my teeth explode!

==== Credits ====
Engine:
Allnighter, South Imp
Production:
Allnighter, South Imp
Testing:
Lots of forum friends
Intro:
Pure Blue Guardian (forum member)
BBK Game Team
June 2004
Swordwarden: Let me show you my new ultimate move!
I'm no pushover either. Let's see who's tougher.
Lampwarden 1: Who dares run wild in here?
Lampwarden 2: Who dares run wild in here?
Lampwarden 3: Who dares run wild in here?
Lampwarden 4: Who dares run wild in here?
Lampwarden 5: Who dares run wild in here?
Lampwarden 6: Who dares run wild in here?
Lampwarden 7: Who dares run wild in here?
Lampwarden 8: Who dares run wild in here?
The Four Symbols Godslayer Array is broken!
Godslayer: Who dares barge into my Godslayer Array? I'll scatter your soul to the winds!
I haven't finished the job Master gave me. How can I go back now?!
I'd better go back up the mountain and report first.
There's no turning back for us now.
I'd better stick to the real business.
Outlander Allnighter: Hey, how did my card end up in your hands?
Outlander Allnighter: Well, I've got a ratty old robe here. But it'll cost you every coin you're carrying. Deal?
Outlander Allnighter: Young man, you've got brains, but no sense of adventure.
Outlander Allnighter: Haha, I'm rich!! Ha... ha... ha... ha...
Outlander Allnighter: All right, since you gave my card back, I'll teach you a move.
You don't have the Bug Card.
Outlander Allnighter: What I hate most is people who lie to me. You'll regret this!
Outlander Tiny Tot: My BF says you're off to a big battle, so he told me to come make a little money off you. But first you have to give me the Tot Card, okay? Hehe!
Outlander Tiny Tot: Hmph. No card, no sale.
Outlander Tiny Tot: I've made my fortune. Bye-bye, I'm off...
Outlander South Imp: I lost my game-team member card. You haven't seen it, have you?
Outlander South Imp: Oh?! You found my card? Give it back and I'll teach you a peerless martial art.
Outlander South Imp: Hmph. Don't come crying to me later, kid.
Outlander South Imp: Hahahaha! Young man, you'll go far.
Outlander South Imp: Now you want to give it back? Well, I don't want it anymore.
Outlander South Imp: How could you sell it?! You're paying me for that.
Oh right, I should go see Xiaomei first.
I've got plenty of fine weapons here.
I've got plenty of fine goods here.
Granny Cai has been acting strange lately. She keeps herself shut up in her room.
Dongdong: Sigh, the demons have gotten so bad lately. Everyone's on edge...
Dongdong: Now that the monster's dead, things are much more relaxed. We can even go out for a stroll at night again.
Old Meng: My boyfriend Ah Jun hasn't come back to see me in ages. I miss him so much. Could you take a letter to him for me?
I wonder when he'll come back.
Everyone calls me "Madman", but I'm actually very handsome!
Ah Xia: Being a clerk in the development department is a lot more work than you'd think.

Ah Xia: Nobody's seen Granny Cai's daughter, Little Painter, for days. Li Hu, the bully of Stonedream, snatches girls in broad daylight, and Granny Cai went to the market there a few days ago... I hope it's not that. How awful...
Oh, my daughter... Now I'm just a lonely old woman with no one left. I might as well die and be done with it!
Granny, please don't talk like that. I'll rescue your daughter.
That Li Hu is the town bully, with over a hundred thugs. Don't go throwing your life away.
Don't worry, Granny, my kung fu is really good. I'm not bragging - forget a hundred, I could knock down a thousand in the blink of an eye.
Really?! If you can bring my girl back, I'll give anything! I'm counting on you, Master Taoist.
Oh my, benefactor, you've come! My daughter is back home. She's staying at her uncle's for now.
I have a family heirloom. Please accept it, benefactor - don't turn it down.
Come and visit whenever you have time.
Hello, I'm Liu Qingfeng, a disciple of Wuji of Sanqing Hall. Are you the Elder of Heartsease?
I am. This old man is Murong Xuan. What can I do for you, Master Taoist?
My master said there are demons here. He sent me.
So you've come to rid us of the monster! At last, a savior!
So there really is a demon. Master sure lives up to his reputation.
The monster is half man, half snake. Two days ago it came to our village demanding young boys, and said it would wipe us all out if we refused. Four people have been killed already.
Do you know where the monster is now?
Only that it comes and goes from the Miasma Wood south of the village.
Rest easy, Elder. I'll go get rid of it right now.
I have a daughter who has studied medicine since she was little. She can lend you a hand.
I'd like to go with you and fight the demon, Master Taoist.
Then let's set off right away.
Master Taoist, Xiaomei, please be careful!
Brother Liu, you came to see me! I'm so glad.
I'm on my way to Mt. Zhong to help my uncle deal with some demons. I was passing by, so I thought I'd drop in.
Demons... I want to come too.
It's not like last time. Even my uncle is calling for help. It's dangerous.
I'm not afraid. I'm all alone now, with nothing to hold me back. I'm sure my dad would agree if he were here!
How did we end up here?
Murong Xiaomei: This is the Heartsease Graveyard. It's very close to the village.
Oh no! If the old snake came out this way, it must have gone to the village. Let's hurry back!
Snake Demon: You dare bring in help against me? I'll kill every last one of you...
Xiaomei, don't grieve too much. I'm so sorry...
Mm. I'll take care of myself.
I have to go back and report to my master. You don't need to see me off any further.
Take care, and come back to see us often.
Let's head up the mountain first.
The miasma here is so thick there's no way to get in!
My family has hunted here for generations. I know this area like the back of my hand.
Excuse me, hunter, how can I get into the Miasma Wood here?
The miasma in that wood is deadly. Unless you wear the "Reed Mail", you'll be dead within moments of going in.
What kind of treasure is this "Reed Mail"?
They say it's armor made by Lord Lu that protects against poison. It was handed down to his descendant, Lu Fu, who lives in Stonedream, not far from here.
Snake Demon: I told you to bring the boys to the edge of the Miasma Wood after dark. What are you doing here now?
Look closely, old snake. This Taoist is here to sort you out!
Snake Demon: You're tough, I'll give you that. I'll seal you in this cave for good!
Snake Demon: My, what big talk. I was getting a bit peckish - you'll make a nice snack.
Snake Demon: Looks like this snack won't go down so easily.
Xiaomei, tonight Brother Liu is treating you to snake soup.
Snake Demon: This brat's getting cockier by the minute.
This is no place to play around. Get lost!
Anyone who dares make trouble here gets his legs broken!
These two dogs sure are fierce @#%@#!@#
Hmph, dealing with you two was a piece of cake.
Guard 1: Kid, you want to die? Happy to oblige.
Guard 2: And the girl goes to the Boss.
Don't be scared, Xiaomei. These two are nothing.
Mm. Don't waste words on them. Let's beat these dogs.
It's nice to come into town for some fun now and then.
I wonder where I can buy flowers.
Plenty of rain this year. Should be a good harvest.
There's a big mansion in this town. It belongs to Li Hu.
Show mercy where you can, and good things will come back to you.
Without simplicity, one cannot show one's will; without calm, one cannot reach far.
Old Wang: Ah, hero, you've come! Welcome!
Old Wang: This is my wife. She used to be a wet nurse at Li Manor, so she knows the place well.
Mrs. Wang: Thank you for sparing my husband.
Show mercy where you can. Besides, Old Wang isn't really a bad guy.
Mrs. Wang: Back when I was a wet nurse at Li Manor, I often heard the other servants whisper about a secret passage there.
Old Wang: It's true, I've heard it too.
Old Wang: Drop by anytime, hero.
Mrs. Wang: I wonder if Old Wang will be home for dinner.
I've got plenty of fine medicine here.
I've got plenty of fine goods here.
You won't find fairer prices anywhere.
I've got plenty of fine weapons here.
Excuse me, is this the home of Lord Lu's descendant?
It is. I am Lu Fu. What brings you here, Master Taoist?
I need to go into the Miasma Wood south of Heartsease to slay a demon. I was hoping to borrow the Reed Mail.
Ah, you're a little too late, Master Taoist. Yesterday Li Hu, the town bully, came with a gang and took it.
I'll get it back for you right away. But afterwards, you have to lend it to me first.
Of course. Thank you in advance.
Him again! I'll get it back for you right away. But afterwards, you have to lend it to me first.
Of course. Thank you in advance.
Mr. Lu, I've got your treasure back.
You fight demons and uphold the Way. I'd like you to keep the treasure.
I'm a descendant of Lord Lu, but sadly the family has fallen on hard times...
Those who do evil bring ruin on themselves.
Reckless whelp! You dare poke the tiger?
Li Hu, you've done nothing but evil. Today I'll deliver justice in Heaven's name!
Don't be afraid. I'm here to save you.
Girl: Thank you both for saving my life!
You must be Granny Cai's daughter, Little Painter?
Granny Cai is waiting for you at home. Hurry back.
Fighting for justice sure feels good.
Old Wang: I'm just an ordinary servant. Please don't kill me!
Don't listen to his lies. He led the way every time they did something rotten.
You won't change your ways. You deserve to die!
Thank you, hero! I live here in Stonedream. Come find me if you ever need anything.
Old Wang: So you think the tiger's a sick cat just because it hasn't roared? I'm not scared of you. Bring it on!
I think we'd better hurry to Mt. Heming.
Hurry up the mountain and help!
A whirlpool! We can use it to get down into the sea.
The seawater here is so dense even a stone would barely sink, let alone a person.
Lots of people here. We could ask around whether anyone's seen Sister Yuan.
Right. Let's ask at that inn we stayed at last time.
I don't think this is the way to Whitewater.
I don't think this is the way to Mt. Zhong.
Whoa! Who left a money pouch lying in here?!
Passerby: Hey, that's my money pouch! Hand it over!
Passerby: Kid, you're asking for a beating! Boys, get him!!!
Finders keepers, losers weepers - the law's on my side!
Passerby: Tough guy, huh? We're out of here.
Passerby: Smart kid, you know what's good for you. Come on, boys, drinks are on me.
Why do I get the feeling I just got conned...
Passerby: You again? Following us? Want a beating?
Passerby: Tough guy, huh? We're out of here.
Sorry, sir, upstairs is under construction. It's not open yet.
I'm just having a look around.
Innkeeper: What can I do for you, sir?
Innkeeper, have you seen the young lady who was with us last time?
Oh, yes. She had lunch here just yesterday. When she left, I think she headed toward Whitewater.
Innkeeper: Will you be staying the night, sir, or having a meal?
Neither, thanks. We have to keep moving.
I've got plenty of top-quality weapons.
I've got plenty of top-quality goods.
You won't find fairer prices anywhere.
I've got plenty of top-quality medicines.
Ah Jun: Around town they call me Lockmaster - there's no lock I can't open. I wonder when Old Meng's letter will arrive!
So you must be Ah Jun, Old Meng's boyfriend?
Ah Jun: That's right. You know her?
When I was in Heartsease, she asked me to bring you this letter.
Handed the Love Letter to Ah Jun.
Ah Jun: Thanks for bringing it all this way. Here are three keys I made after years of study. Call it a small thank-you.
Ah Jun: I haven't been home in ages. I should go back and visit.
Thief: Out of the way! Out of the way!
Catching thieves is my specialty. Leave this to me.
Weird, how did the thief turn into a girl...
Sister, you clearly have real skill. So why would you...
My name is Yuan Pingzhi. I'd rather not talk about my past.
Skills like that, and wasted on this. What a shame.
Sister Yuan, demons run wild these days. With skills like yours, why not help rid the people of them?
When I woke up this morning, Sister Yuan wasn't here. She must have left.
Oh well, everyone has their own path. Let's head for Mt. Zhong.
There's still something important to take care of here!
Taoist Chongxu: Qingfeng, the demons have retreated... Why have you come out?
Uncle, it's all because my skills weren't good enough. The Tyrant Bell has been stolen.
Taoist Chongxu: It is the will of Heaven... Are you hurt? ...Where is Miss Yuan?
We're fine. Xiaomei and I were knocked out, and when we came to, she was gone.
Taoist Chongxu: The fate of all living things depends on this. The Tyrant Bell must be recovered.
I'll go and bring the Tyrant Bell back.
Taoist Chongxu: Good. Leave the mountain at once and find Miss Yuan first. I suspect she has a great deal to do with this.
Taoist Chongxu: I must stay to run things on the mountain. Find the Tyrant Bell as fast as you can, before the land is drowned in suffering.
We have plenty of fine medicines to choose from.
I've been waiting here for you a long time. I've thought it over - I'm joining you.
Something's not right... Oh no, Uncle's in danger!
Thunderling: You pack of demons dare run riot here? Today Lord Thunder is going to round up the lot of you!
Zhong Taoist: Thank goodness you got here in time, Brother Liu, or we'd have been done for.
Take me to my uncle, quickly.
Zhong Taoist: Yes. Master is waiting for you on the back mountain.
Taoist Chongxu: Qingfeng, you came just in time. You've broken the demons' siege of Mt. Zhong.
No need to thank me, Uncle. Slaying demons and defending the Way is my duty.
Taoist Chongxu: Well done. I believe this great demon assault on Mt. Zhong is aimed at the Tyrant Bell. Its power is immense - if it fell into demon hands, the consequences would be unthinkable.
I'll do everything I can to protect the Tyrant Bell.
Taoist Chongxu: Good. One more thing. Miss Yuan, behind you, carries a strong demonic aura - yet there's righteousness in her too. Keep an eye on her.
Taoist Chongxu: Go and get some rest for now.
Zhong Taoist: Master asks you to come to the back mountain.

Taoist Chongxu: Qingfeng, I've divined that the demons will launch an all-out attack on Mt. Zhong today, and I fear my disciples can't hold them. You should be able to guard the Bell in the cave. I'll go meet the enemy.
Yes. I'll go into the cave right away.
I wonder how the battle outside is going.
Crimson: Not bad, you lot. But you'll never withstand my ultimate move!
Liu Qingfeng and Murong Xiaomei pass out.
That old demon is really something.
She wasn't here when I woke up.
Could Uncle have been right about her? Let's go find him.
Crimson: Hahahaha, the Tyrant Bell is mine! Haha...
Mayor: You're all back! You're not hurt, are you?
Mayor: Good, good. What happened in there?
We've wiped out the demons inside. The old demon left the missing children in the dry well at the old manor. Go and bring them out. They're in a deathlike sleep, but they'll wake up in seven days.
Mayor: You two, go rescue them.
Mayor: You are our town's great benefactors. We've nothing fine to offer, but please come to my humble home for a cup of tea.
Let's head north after the Tyrant Bell.
Watchman: You can't go in here.
We'd like to go in and take a look.
Watchman: There are ghosts in there. The Mayor told us to stand guard so nobody goes in and gets hurt.
Watchman: We follow the Mayor's orders.
Passerby: Oh, son, look how big you've grown! And that must be my daughter-in-law next to you.
Passerby: You're not my son. Who are you? Who are you?
Passerby: My boy, my boy... boy...
Passerby: Why did you take my son away? You...
Passerby: When Heaven is about to give my son a great mission, it will surely first...
Let's have a look around first, shall we?
There's something odd about this well.
The sound seems to be coming from inside the well.
Great martial arts won't always save you, but a good weapon will always give you the edge.
Sigh... So many children missing. Where on earth do we even look...
Excuse me, are you the Mayor?
Mayor: I am. I'm the Mayor of Whitewater.
I hear children go missing here every day. I suspect it has something to do with the old manor to the south. We'd like to go in and investigate.
Mayor: No, no, no. I appreciate the kind offer, but that old manor is far too dangerous.
We're not afraid. We know how to deal with demons.
Mayor: No, no, no. That old manor really is too dangerous.
Mayor: Whoever goes in rarely comes out. A Taoist once went in to subdue the demon and never came back. Yesterday a young lady insisted on going in, and she still hasn't come out.
Mayor: I won't let the same mistake happen again. I can't allow you to go in.
Mayor: Sigh, when I think of that girl, I still feel guilty. A stranger in town, all alone...
Mayor, the young lady you mentioned is our friend. We came all the way from Mt. Zhong to find her. Slaying demons and defending the Way @!$#@!$, not to mention #$%!#@!@#
Mayor: Very well, I'll let you in. But promise me that at the first sign of danger, you'll run straight back.
Mayor: Do drop by again when you have time.
Innkeeper: Will you be having a meal, sir, or staying the night?
We've seen a lot of people wandering the streets like they've lost their minds. What's going on? Could you tell us, Innkeeper?
Innkeeper: You must be from out of town, sir. A lot of strange things have been happening here lately.
Innkeeper: Every night, some family in town has a child vanish without a trace. Those crazed folk in the streets lost their children, couldn't find them anywhere, and went mad with grief.
Innkeeper: And lately, every night, you can hear a woman crying in an old manor to the south. It's terrifying.
Innkeeper: Will you be having a meal, sir, or staying the night?
This is an old, established shop. Everyone around here knows us.
My shop may be small, but I've still got some good stuff.
You won't find fairer prices anywhere.
I think I hear something outside.
The crying seems to be getting louder.
It's so gloomy in here. It gives me the creeps.
The killing aura here is overwhelming. Some powerful demon must have set up an array here to train.
There's someone over there. I think it's Sister Yuan.
Careful! This is a Soulsnare Array. It drains the souls and spirit energy of anyone who enters, to power the evil art of Soulsnare. It's one of the Seven Evil Arrays.
Is there any way to break it?
Dig up the pregnant women buried head-down at its eight trigram points and set them upright. Buried alive like that, their yin is fierce - they can become any monster.
Right where those eight stones are. Be careful.
We shouldn't stick around here. Let's get out, fast.
Crimson: You again! I failed to kill you last time, and now you've wrecked my Soulsnare Array. Nothing but your deaths will soothe my rage this time!
Hmph! You stole the Tyrant Bell that day and left me to take the blame. I won't spare you either!
Crimson: Well, kid, you've actually gotten better.
Scared, huh? Hand over the Tyrant Bell, or you won't even get to stay a demon.
Crimson: Big talk. I've already given the Tyrant Bell to its rightful owner. Too bad you'll never get to meet him. Hahaha... Have at you!
I can't move right now. It's all up to you!
Miss Yuan, what are you doing here?
After Mt. Zhong, with you two dazed by Crimson's Soulsnare, I went after him alone. The missing children of Whitewater led me here, but I blundered into the array.
No. If it weren't for you two, I might not even be alive. Oh right, what brings you here?
We were tracking things down too.
This place is too dangerous. Let's get out first and talk later.
Murong Xiaomei and Yuan Pingzhi join the party.
Mayor: Won't you honored benefactors stay a little longer?
No, we have urgent business, so we can't stay. Thank you for your warm hospitality.
Mayor: It was the least I could do. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Mayor, have you seen anyone pass through here with a big bell in the last couple of days?
Mayor: Actually, yes. The day before yesterday, a band of strange-looking folk came through town dragging a huge bell.
Do you know who they were?
Mayor: No idea. All I know is they headed north.
Thank you. We'll be on our way.
Mayor: Let me see you out.
Mayor: Then do drop by again when you have time.
Murong Xiaomei and Yuan Pingzhi join the party.
Villager: This is Lord Zhou's hometown. I heard a great treasure of the demonkind is hidden in this village, so I came a long way to find it. Sigh, and I still haven't found it!
Villager: A few days ago Lord Zhou's spirit appeared and warned that a bloody disaster will soon strike Nanbei Village.
Villager: Lord Zhou's spirit said three outsiders, one man and two women, would come to the village, and only they could avert the disaster.
Villager: Hey, one man and two women - that's you! Lord Zhou is never wrong!
Villager: Lord Zhou is never wrong!
Villager A: Lord Zhou's spirit appeared and said a bloody disaster is coming.
Villager B: I'm not scared. If you've done nothing wrong, you don't fear a knock at the door at midnight.
Villager A: Where did that reek wind just now come from? It stank something awful.
Villager B: Tell me about it! Two people at the village gate got knocked out by it, and they're still unconscious!
Villager A: What a world we live in... sigh...
Excuse me, how are the unconscious villagers doing?
Villager A: Still haven't woken up. I fear the worst.
I've got two pills here. Give them these and their lives will be saved.
Villager B: You're such good people!
Villager B: They say Fengdu is a city of ghosts. I wonder if it's true.
We haven't gotten Zhou Chu's big reward yet. Leaving now would be a waste...
This was once a great treasure of the Demon Realm. It was lost to the mortal world during the War of Gods and Demons.
How do you know so much about it?
Sister Yuan knows so many things, no wonder she can't remember where she heard them all.
Zhou Chu: I have been waiting for you three for some time.

Zhou Chu: My recent divinations show that the South Hill White Tiger and the North Sea Blue Dragon, whom I slew long ago, are stirring back to life. But this time is different: my readings are muddled, as if something is interfering.
Zhou Chu: I'd like you to find out what is going on. You will be richly rewarded.
Zhou Chu: I trust you three have already dealt with the White Tiger.
Hmph, you never say anything straight. Yes, the White Tiger's done for. But two villagers got knocked out by its reek wind - what are you going to do about that?
Zhou Chu: Ah, I have two Bliss Pills here. Give them to those two quickly, or not only will they die, a plague may break out.
Zhou Chu: The Blue Dragon's Blood Rain plagues the world just like the White Tiger's reek wind. You must destroy it quickly.
Zhou Chu: You three kept your word. I thank you on behalf of all living things.
Just thanks? Weren't you promising a big reward?
Zhou Chu: I have a book here. Please take it.
Times aren't very peaceful lately. Best to carry a weapon.
Times are hard. I've got no choice but to sell cheap.
I gather all my herbs myself. Quality guaranteed.
Passerby: Whoa, who are you? Never seen you before. Are you people or ghosts?
What a weird guy. Ghosts, in broad daylight?
Passerby: Don't scare a guy like that, you'll scare me to death! These days nobody dares say even half the word 'ghost', even in broad daylight.
Passerby: I don't get it. I never go out at night, so how come I see them in the daytime too? I never did anything to offend them...
Passerby: I wonder if the one I saw yesterday was my great-grandfather who died ages ago. I'd better go burn incense for him tomorrow.
Passerby A: I got scared again yesterday at noon. Now my nerves are shot.
Passerby B: Sigh, my wife went out for groceries yesterday afternoon and fainted from fright. She still can't get out of bed! What a curse...
Whoa, what's that in the well? Something's glinting down there.
My weapons are all top-notch. Come, have a look.
Innkeeper: Will you be dining or staying the night, sir?
Innkeeper, may I ask why everyone here looks like they've seen a ghost?
Innkeeper: You've hit the nail on the head, sir. They really were scared by ghosts.

Innkeeper: You wouldn't know, sir - this is Fengdu, the ghost city. Here no one walks the streets at night: the living own the day, the ghosts own the night. But lately some ghosts come out by day and give people terrible frights.
Oh, really? Innkeeper, we'll stay here tonight.
Innkeeper: Where are you going, sir?
Innkeeper: Please don't go out, sir! Nothing out there right now is human. I won't even open my front door.
Don't worry, we're just going to catch up with some old friends.
My medicines work for everyone - people, ghosts and gods alike.
A pawnshop needn't be big, but it must be fair.
Got lots of new stock lately. Have a look even if you don't buy.
The yin energy here is strong. Let's find the Ghost King - he's bound to know...
Bai Wuchang: You're living people? Don't you know the rules here?
We want to see the Ghost King.
Bai Wuchang: Oh, hee hee, ha ha! If you want to see the Ghost King, you have to die first.
We have to see the Ghost King!
Well? Take us to see the Ghost King.

Bai Wuchang: If my brother Hei Wuchang weren't away on business, you'd never have won. We'll have a rematch someday! The Ghost King is at the City God Temple in the south of town. I'm not coming - the old man's had a foul temper lately.
Bai Wuchang: Then I'll grant your wish.

Ghost King: The yin energy has grown far too strong, all because the demons of the world have come back to life. They keep harassing the ghostkind, so the spirits get no rest and roam about even in broad daylight.
Ghost King: Sanqing Hall! Perfect timing.
Ghost King: You're the better fighter. Kill me if you like.
We really didn't come here looking for trouble.
Ghost King: Spare me the act. The ghostkind will never bow to Patriarch Tiandao.
I think you've misunderstood. We came looking for the Tyrant Bell we lost a few days ago, not to make you surrender.
Ghost King: That bell is called the Tyrant Bell? It's yours?
Yes. It was stolen by the demonkind.
Ghost King: So you're not Tiandao's people.
I'm from Sanqing Hall. Have you seen the bell?

Ghost King: The demonkind keep harassing us. Their monsters left word: within three days the ghostkind must bow to Patriarch Tiandao, or be wiped out. Tiandao heads the Way of the Five Pecks of Rice, and my rage at him makes me hate every Taoist alive. The monsters carry a bell of boundless power: any ghost trapped under it melts into a pool of blood, body and soul destroyed. We lose every battle - even our vanguard generals Ox-Head and Horse-Face are gone. That must be your Tyrant Bell.
The monsters who stole the bell are tied to Tiandao...
Ghost King: You lost the bell, so I hope you'll settle this. Tiandao is on Mt. Heming. Leave Fengdu heading west and keep going, and you'll get there.
Ghost King: I swore that any Taoist I meet dies!
We didn't come here looking for trouble.
Ghost King: Enough talk. Have at you...
I think I'm going to be sick.
The White Tiger must be nearby. Let's search carefully.
Tiger Thrall: Hey, kid, barging into our cave like that - you know that means death!
Tiger Thrall: You don't know what's good for you... Boys, get him!
Tiger Thrall: Not bad. No wonder the boss is wary of you.
Let's search carefully. We can't let it get away again.
White Tiger: Shit, I turned into a bunch of haystacks and STILL couldn't fool you!!!
White Tiger: The hills stay green and the rivers keep flowing - until we meet again!
White Tiger: Come on, let's settle this with kung fu.
White Tiger: Hmph, you only got me because you came while I was still training my Reek Wind art. If I'd mastered it, you'd never have lasted this long.
Why is the water blood-red everywhere? Not a sign of life - it's as if time has stopped here.
Kung fu this lame, and you call yourselves dragons?
North Sea Wyrm: You just wait, I'll !@#$!#!$#!@@#$!
North Sea Drake: You remember this, I won't @#$!#!$#!@@#$!
North Sea Wyrm: What? You dare call me, the North Sea Wyrm, a lizard? Oh, you and I are going to have words about this...
North Sea Wyrm: Hmph, scared now? Too late. I'm going to cut out your tongue.
I'm just scared you're too big for us to finish eating, haha...
North Sea Wyrm: Argh, you're driving me mad!
North Sea Wyrm: What? Calling my brother Drake a dog I could let slide, but now you insult me too? You're asking to die.
Sigh, another one. What a pain...
North Sea Wyrm: Now you know how tough I am.
Sigh, looks like we really can't finish eating you.
North Sea Drake: What? You dare call me, the North Sea Drake, a puppy? Oh, you and I are going to have words about this...
North Sea Drake: Hmph, scared now? Too late. I'm going to cut out your tongue.
I'm just scared you're too big for us to finish eating, haha...
North Sea Drake: Argh, you're driving me mad!
North Sea Drake: What? Calling my brother Wyrm a lizard I could let slide, but you dare call me a dog? You're asking to die.
Sigh, another one. What a pain...
North Sea Drake: No one who insults me, human or demon, has ever come to a good end.
Then let's see whose kung fu is tougher!
North Sea Wyrm: You only beat us because we were split up. That doesn't count!
North Sea Drake: Now we'll take you on together.
Blue Dragon: Hahahaha... I didn't misjudge you. Anyone who can beat the White Tiger shouldn't lose to my Wyrm Guard and Drake Guard. But you'll never defeat me. Have a taste of my Blood Rain!
Blue Dragon: Not bad at all. Too bad you can't beat me.
Is this a village? Why is it so desolate...
What are we waiting for? Straight up the mountain!
Villager A: Those monsters come every few days. Next time it might be us lying on the ground.
Villager B: Sigh, Heaven has no eyes...
The demonkind have gone too far.
Let's fight our way up the mountain!
Villager: What do we do, what do we do? Those monsters are sure to...
Let's get into the cave first.
I'll kill every last one of you demons... kill...
Who dares barge onto Mt. Heming?
Tiandao: If I can't rule the Three Realms of demons, gods and men, then no one else will either.
Tiandao laughs long and loud, then dies.

Red Phoenix (Yuan Pingzhi): In Nanbei Village, Zhou Chu showed me how to turn from evil. Seeing how strong the demonkind had grown and the misery they caused, I had long wanted to turn back. I just feared you couldn't accept the truth, so I never found the chance to tell you. Now that it's all out in the open, I actually feel at peace.

Red Phoenix: I was one of the Star Lords of the Four Symbols. I gave in to my inner demon and trained the demonic art Fireplume Demonform, and as Heaven's punishment Perfected Xuanxu sealed me in Demon Cave on Sanqing's back mountain. While sealed I wanted to turn to good, but Wuji offered to break my seal, and I gave in again. For him I set up the Four Symbols Godslayer Array, to stop anyone climbing the mountain to disturb his demonic arts.

Red Phoenix: The monsters at Heartsease and the demons who raided Mt. Zhong were all Wuji's doing. But the demons' revival was Liu Qingfeng's own work. Wuji had trained his demonic arts, the Myriad Demon Metamorphosis, to the 7th level, and found he needed the fury of the world's suffering to go further. He was already seven-tenths demon; had he broken the seals in Demon Cave himself, the Primal Demonbane Array would have destroyed him body and soul. So he used Liu Qingfeng to free the demons.

Red Phoenix: Wuji put me at Liu Qingfeng's side to get rid of him once he had killed Tiandao. The demons that raided Mt. Zhong were Tiandao's men. Tiandao knew Wuji's plan, but he had long coveted the Tyrant Bell, and with Wuji not stepping in, it was the chance of a lifetime. Tiandao also knew my mission, so even in death he forced out my true form to ruin Wuji's scheme. But he never expected the Tyrant Bell to fail against Liu Qingfeng - still less that Zhou Chu would change my heart...

Red Phoenix: You must reach Sanqing Hall within three days and destroy Wuji. Once he masters the tenth level of the Myriad Demon Metamorphosis, not even the highest immortals can stop him. At the tenth level he can turn anything into a demon, and the demons he makes cannot die. Now that I've seen the light, I have no regrets!!

Red Phoenix: The Chaos Urn sits inside the Four Symbols Godslayer Array. The souls of the Four Symbols that built it were drawn into the Urn to control the array. Return the four souls to their places and the array will fail. You still need the Turtle Orb - sadly I can't go with you to find it. Even out of control, the Urn can drain the soul of anyone who enters, so you'll need the Heaven Lamp to protect you.
Red Phoenix: I have a move called "Dragon Cloud Grab". I hope it serves you well.
The Red Phoenix takes her own life.
The sound of a demon horde draws near.
Brother Liu, it sounds like a whole horde of demons is coming this way. We'd better hide first.
Wha... what...? There's a cave over there. Get inside first...
Tiandao: That's me, boy. So you've finally come!
Tiandao, you've led the demons to ravage the world. Today I'll do Heaven's justice...

Tiandao: Boy, you're nothing but Wuji's pawn. He's the real archfiend menacing the world. The demons' revival and their cruelty are all Wuji's doing - I just rode the wave. I can see you've got talent. How about it? Join me. At least I'm more upfront than Wuji.
Damn you! You've fallen to the demonic path and now you slander my master? Today I'll kill you for sure...
Red Phoenix: Liu Qingfeng, you're the only one who can stop Wuji...
Sounds like stone breaking over there.
Dark Turtle: Whoever invades this tomb dies.
Dark Turtle: Heh heh, now you know how tough I am!
You're the Dark Turtle? Then you've got the Turtle Orb, right?
Dark Turtle: Oh? That depends on what you can do.
The last few characters are really strange.
Sage Spirit: I am a fragment of Zhang Daoling's soul. I still clung to the world, so I could not ascend. Today you have set me free.
If you're the Celestial Master's soul, then you must know what kind of man my master Wuji is?
Sage Spirit: What a misfortune for the Taoist order, to produce two depraved archfiends like Tiandao and Wuji...
Master really has become a demon... how could... this...

We're near Heartsease. The Celestial Master's soul sent us here as he ascended - you were out cold. He said you must get rid of Wuji fast, or once he turns demon, the world will face a disaster like never before.
Who disturbs my meditation again? If I can't reach enlightenment, you're not getting away either...
